g.text: Three Layers — Authoring Surface, Presentation Content, and the Seam
Module M { Theory T(p: P) { … } theory T(A) }
The surface parser emits a value; it does not feed a second
backend model. Directly constructed and surface-derived values run through the
same decoder, validator, semantic fingerprint, and GrammarCore lowering.
remains the typed compile-time path for existing grammars and
projects into GrammarCore for conformance. It does not detour through the image VM.
— which is why it, and not the text,
is normative for identity and interchange.
L0 — Greg and Mike's Module / Theory surface
L2 — GrammarCore, the shared generalized seam
The backends box carries the neutral GROUPING wash #F8FAFC, not a
semantic fill: it names four generators collectively and asserts nothing
about them. Two of the four emit Rust source and two emit data — figures 1
and 6 draw that split, which is their subject and not this figure's.
an equality obligation — here, surface/value parity
